overclaims: In August 2025 Google's Kaggle Game Arena pitted eight leading LLMs against each other at chess without giving them lists of legal moves.
Chess.com reported that in all but one first-round match, more games ended in illegal-move forfeits than in checkmate.
Some models (Grok 4, o3) played legal games consistently in the tournament.
In a tournament of eight leading LLMs, most first-round matches had more games lost to illegal moves than to checkmate.
checks.note: The packet does not establish that legal-move lists were withheld. Only one match having more checkmates does not mean all others had more forfeits: the o4-mini match had two checkmates in four games. Consistent legal play by Grok 4 and o3 throughout the tournament is not established by this day-one report.
